decisions.moe_dup_fraction: 0.2987 per-layer mean (L.A.I.L 0.2800, code 0.3081; layers 0.0985-0.4502, median 0.3102; random 0.0232). Ceiling 6.69 ms/step upper / 5.22 realistic (7.9% of 66 ms) with the tool's 22.4 ms p2b; 6.48 / 5.06 with the s5-measured p2b of 21.7 ms/step.
decisions.ar_skew: pre-draft: rank1 reaches the draft-start AR 0.067 ms (L.A.I.L) / 0.070 ms (code) later than rank0 (census pre_draft r0 3.061 / r1 3.128 ms), mirrored by r0 waiting 0.047 / 0.051 ms longer in the draft. Trace: draft-start skew mean +47 us but |skew| 151 us, so it is mostly symmetric host jitter in sample->propose (idle before draft embedding 262 us r0 vs 398 us r1). About 0.1% of a step, not worth a fix. Larger asymmetry: rank0 (spark1) is the straggler inside the target. It arrives late at 80-85% of in-layer ARs by 12-13 us each and at the target-start AR by ~90 us on 97% of steps. Rank1 waits 2.45 ms/step in collectives vs 1.31 on rank0. Rank0's non-NCCL kernel time is +1.32 ms/step (+2.2%), spread evenly over the bandwidth-bound kernels (p2b +0.36, b12x dense +0.355, each +1.7%). Spark1 SM clock is 2177 vs 2190 MHz (-0.6%) at the same 88% util, and host load is head-only (EngineCore 92% CPU, API server).
